mechanism: Torsemide-induced volume depletion and reduced renal perfusion increases gentamicin nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risk through decreased glomerular filtration and elevated drug accumulation in renal tubules.
action: Monitor renal function closely, maintain adequate hydration, use lowest effective diuretic dose, and consider alternative antibiotics or aminoglycoside monitoring (peak/trough levels) if combination is necessary.
